title: What's New in v2.9.18
notes: 🏆 Alliance Championship 5-Round Clashes: Brand new public dashboard featuring head-to-head match cards with live scores, custom opponent tags, and dynamic victory/defeat badges for all 5 tournament rounds.

⚔️ Championship Matchup & Score Manager: Dedicated R4/R5 admin editor for updating scores, auto-calculating overall win/loss records, archiving completed seasons to the Championship Vault, and seamlessly managing member signups.
